Title: Private Account
Description: Restrict posts and profile visibility to approved followers only
Steps: 1. Open Profile|2. Tap Menu icon|3. Go to Settings and Privacy|4. Tap Account Privacy|5. Toggle Private Account on

Title: Activity Status Off
Description: Hide your last seen and online status from other users
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Messages and Story Replies|3. Toggle Show Activity Status off

Title: Disable Story Resharing
Description: Prevent others from resharing your stories to their own
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Story|3. Toggle Allow Resharing to Stories off

Title: Manual Tag Approval
Description: Review and approve tags before they appear on your profile
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Tags and Mentions|3. Set Allow Tags to Manually Approve

Title: Limit Ad Data Usage
Description: Reduce data used for ad targeting under Ad Preferences
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Ads|3. Tap Ad Topics|4. Turn off unwanted topics

Title: Two-Factor Authentication
Description: Enable 2FA using an authenticator app instead of SMS
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Accounts Center|3. Tap Password and Security|4. Tap Two-Factor Authentication|5. Select Authentication App

Title: Review Login Activity
Description: Check and log out unrecognized active sessions
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Accounts Center|3. Tap Password and Security|4. Tap Where You Are Logged In|5. Log out unrecognized devices

Title: Revoke Third-Party App Access
Description: Remove unused apps and websites connected to your account
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Accounts Center|3. Tap Apps and Websites|4. Remove unused connections

Title: Strip Location From Posts
Description: Disable precise location sharing for the app in OS settings
Steps: 1. Open phone Settings|2. Go to Apps or Privacy|3. Select Instagram|4. Set Location permission to Never or While Using with Precise Location off

Title: Download Your Information
Description: Periodically audit stored data via the data export tool
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Accounts Center|3. Tap Your Information and Permissions|4. Tap Download Your Information|5. Request export

Title: Protect Your Posts
Description: Make your account private so only approved followers see posts
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Audience and Tagging|4. Toggle Protect Your Posts on

Title: Photo Tagging Restriction
Description: Limit who can tag you in photos to people you follow
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Audience and Tagging|4. Set Photo Tagging to People You Follow

Title: Disable Discoverability
Description: Prevent others from finding your account via email or phone
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Discoverability and Contacts|4. Turn off email and phone discoverability

Title: Turn Off Ad Personalization
Description: Disable use of off-platform activity for ad targeting
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Ads Preferences|4. Turn off Personalized Ads

Title: Remove Location From Posts
Description: Stop attaching location metadata to tweets
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Location Information|4. Turn off Add Location to Tweets

Title: Two-Factor Authentication
Description: Use an authenticator app or security key instead of SMS
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Security and Account Access|3. Tap Security|4. Tap Two-Factor Authentication|5. Select Authenticator App or Security Key

Title: Revoke Connected Apps
Description: Remove unused OAuth app permissions from your account
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Security and Account Access|3. Tap Apps and Sessions|4. Tap Connected Apps|5. Revoke unused apps

Title: Restrict Direct Messages
Description: Disable receiving DMs from accounts you do not follow
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Direct Messages|4. Turn off Allow Message Requests From Everyone

Title: Keyword Mute Filters
Description: Reduce unwanted content exposure using mute and block filters
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Privacy and Safety|3. Tap Mute and Block|4. Tap Muted Keywords|5. Add keywords to mute

Title: Restrict Last Seen and About
Description: Limit visibility of last seen and photo and about to contacts only
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy|3. Set Last Seen and Online to My Contacts|4. Set Profile Photo and About similarly

Title: Disable Read Receipts
Description: Prevent senders from seeing when you have read their messages
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy|3. Toggle Read Receipts off

Title: Restrict Group Invites
Description: Allow only your contacts to add you to groups
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy|3. Tap Groups|4. Set to My Contacts

Title: Enable Disappearing Messages
Description: Set new chats to auto-delete messages by default
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy|3. Tap Default Message Timer|4. Set duration for new chats

Title: Two-Step Verification
Description: Add a PIN required to re-register your phone number
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Account|3. Tap Two-Step Verification|4. Tap Enable|5. Set a six-digit PIN

Title: Audit Linked Devices
Description: Review and remove old or unused linked device sessions
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Linked Devices|3. Review active sessions|4. Log out unused devices

Title: Secure Chat Backup
Description: Disable cloud backup or enable end-to-end encrypted backup
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Chats|3. Tap Chat Backup|4. Turn off auto backup or enable End-to-End Encrypted Backup

Title: Block Unknown Numbers
Description: Manually block and report spam or unrecognized contacts
Steps: 1. Open the chat from unknown number|2. Tap contact name|3. Tap Block|4. Optionally tap Report

Title: Limit Sync Data
Description: Disable or restrict sync to avoid storing history and passwords in the cloud
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap You and Google|3. Tap Sync and Google Services|4. Turn off sync or select specific items to exclude

Title: Block Third-Party Cookies
Description: Prevent cross-site tracking cookies from being set
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Third-Party Cookies|4. Select Block Third-Party Cookies

Title: Disable Ad Privacy Features
Description: Turn off ad topics and site-suggested ads and ad measurement tracking
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Ad Privacy|4. Turn off Ad Topics and Site-Suggested Ads and Ad Measurement

Title: Configure Safe Browsing Level
Description: Choose Standard or Enhanced protection based on your data-sharing preference
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Safe Browsing|4. Select Standard or Enhanced Protection

Title: Default-Deny Site Permissions
Description: Set location and camera and microphone and notifications to ask or block by default
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Site Settings|4. Set each permission category to Ask or Block by default

Title: Clear Cookies on Exit
Description: Automatically delete cookies when the browser closes
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Cookies and Other Site Data|4. Enable Clear Cookies When You Close All Windows

Title: Enable Do Not Track
Description: Send a do-not-track signal to visited sites
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Cookies and Other Site Data|4. Toggle Send a Do Not Track Request on

Title: Separate Browsing Profiles
Description: Use distinct profiles for logged-in Google activity and general browsing
Steps: 1. Click profile icon|2. Tap Add|3. Create a new profile|4. Sign in only on the dedicated profile

Title: Install Tracker Blocker
Description: Use an extension like uBlock Origin to block ads and trackers
Steps: 1. Open Chrome Web Store|2. Search uBlock Origin|3. Click Add to Chrome|4. Confirm installation

Title: Disable Network Prediction
Description: Turn off page preloading to avoid leaking browsing intent
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Privacy and Security|3. Tap Preload Pages|4. Select No Preloading

Title: Private Profile Viewing
Description: Browse profiles anonymously or in semi-private mode
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Visibility|3. Tap Profile Viewing Options|4. Select Private or Semi-Private Mode

Title: Trim Public Profile Visibility
Description: Hide connections list and limit public profile details
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Visibility|3. Tap Edit Your Public Profile|4. Toggle off unwanted sections including Connections

Title: Disable Off-LinkedIn Activity Tracking
Description: Turn off use of activity outside LinkedIn for ad targeting
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Data Privacy|3. Tap Off-LinkedIn Activity|4. Turn off

Title: Restrict Email and Connections Visibility
Description: Set email address and connection list visible only to you
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Visibility|3. Tap Who Can See Your Email|4. Set to Only You|5. Repeat for Connections

Title: Two-Factor Authentication
Description: Enable 2FA for account login
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Sign In and Security|3. Tap Two-Step Verification|4. Turn on and choose method

Title: Disable Contact Sync
Description: Turn off syncing of phone or email contacts
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Data Privacy|3. Tap Sync Contacts|4. Turn off

Title: Hide Job Seeking Signal
Description: Disable notifying your network when you are open to work
Steps: 1. Open Job Seeking Preferences|2. Tap Open to Work|3. Set visibility to Recruiters Only or turn off

Title: Opt Out of Research Participation
Description: Disable salary and research data sharing programs
Steps: 1. Open Settings and Privacy|2. Tap Data Privacy|3. Tap Research Invitations or Salary|4. Opt out

Title: Mandatory Two-Factor Authentication
Description: Require 2FA via authenticator app or hardware security key
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Password and Authentication|3. Click Enable Two-Factor Authentication|4. Set up authenticator app or security key

Title: Audit SSH Keys
Description: Review and remove stale or unused SSH keys
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap SSH and GPG Keys|3. Review listed keys|4. Delete unused ones

Title: Use Fine-Grained Tokens
Description: Prefer scoped personal access tokens with expiry over classic tokens
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Developer Settings|3. Tap Personal Access Tokens|4. Generate a Fine-Grained Token with limited scope and expiry

Title: Keep Email Address Private
Description: Hide your email and block it from being exposed via command-line pushes
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Emails|3. Enable Keep My Email Address Private|4. Enable Block Command Line Pushes That Expose My Email

Title: Hide Private Contribution Activity
Description: Prevent private repo activity from showing on your public timeline
Steps: 1. Open your profile|2. Click Edit Profile|3. Toggle Include Private Contributions on My Profile as desired|4. Save changes

Title: Revoke Unused OAuth Apps
Description: Remove third-party application access you no longer use
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Applications|3. Tap Authorized OAuth Apps|4. Revoke unused apps

Title: Review Organization Access
Description: Check which organizations can view your account data
Steps: 1. Open Settings|2. Tap Organizations|3. Review membership list|4. Leave or adjust visibility for unwanted orgs

Title: Enable Commit Signing
Description: Sign commits with GPG or SSH to prevent impersonation
Steps: 1. Generate a GPG or SSH signing key|2. Open Settings|3. Tap SSH and GPG Keys|4. Add the signing key|5. Configure git to sign commits by default
